about: Portalistic's game fixes: what the bottle applies when a game starts, and what it tells the player when a game quits. Keys: steam:<appid>, gog:<id>, epic:<app name>. Fields: name; note (shown with Portalistic's banner when the game quits, and in the fixes list); env (KEY: value, the game's environment, like guest/games/<appid>.env); args (added to the game's command line); dlloverrides (Wine's WINEDLLOVERRIDES additions); winetricks (verbs installed into the game's prefix once); status: works | needs-login | crashes | wont-run (a known, hard reason) | unlikely (a reason that applies to its class, not tested with this game).
